question: What was the winning throw of Neeraj Chopra in Tokyo Olympics-2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**87.58 m**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **87.58 m** was the winning throw of Neeraj Chopra in the Tokyo Olympics 2020.
 
• Neeraj Chopra's throw secured India's first-ever gold medal in athletics at the Olympics.
 
• The event took place on **August 7, 2021**, as the Tokyo Olympics were postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
